entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We've finally made it. All[n]that remains is to actually[n]send the calling card.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Looks like we'll manage to get[n]it out before that investigation[n]starts going down too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We still don't know anything[n]about the true culprit behind[n]the mental shutdowns though...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if we'll learn anything[n]from Niijima-san's Shadow.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I doubt she has ascertained[n]any relevant clues.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I agree. That is why she has[n]the warrant out on the Phantom[n]Thieves, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Furthermore, the public believes[n]arresting us will solve the case.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The public prosecutors won't stop[n]now. They have the weight of the[n]general public on their shoulders.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If only we knew who the true[n]culprit was, we wouldn't have to[n]fight Niijima-san's Shadow...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Who could it be...? Do you[n]think it's someone we know?
That's a possibility.
I doubt that.
I have no idea.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: True, but there would be no end[n]to the mistrust if we began[n]doubting our peers.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I want to believe that myself,[n]but that might be a little[n]too hopeful...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's someone who holds animosity[n]toward us and can always stay[n]one step ahead of our actions...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hm, you're right. I can't[n]think of a single person who[n]fits that description.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Either way, we only have one[n]opportunity to turn the tables.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This final calling card[n]shall be my magnum opus.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Simply let us know when[n]you're ready, [fName].
